author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Sponsored by Datadog

Most infrastructure teams manage on-prem and cloud with tools that weren't designed to talk to each other. As a result, when incidents show up, correlation can be a source of friction to identify the root cause and engineers are often left manually associating signals from one to the other, piecing together what's actually happening as they go.

And according to new research we ran with 105 senior infrastructure leaders, correlating signals across on-prem and cloud is the top bottleneck teams point to when something breaks.

In this session, we'll explore why correlating on-prem and cloud signals remains one of the biggest sources of friction in hybrid incident response, what's changing as AI takes on more of that correlation work, and what modern monitoring should look like for infrastructure that spans both environments.

We’ll cover:
- Eliminating blind spots between physical infrastructure and cloud-native services
- Slashing investigation time and pinpointin
title: LF Live Webinar: On-Prem and Cloud: Closing the Correlation Gap

author: The Linux Foundation
description:
Open source powers the entire AI software stack.

In his opening keynote at Open Source Summit Korea 2026, Linux Foundation CEO Jim Zemlin explored how open technologies are transforming every layer:

▪️ Agents: MCP, A2A, x402, AGENTS.md and goose are creating an open foundation for agentic AI.
▪️Models: Open-weight models are making intelligence more affordable while approaching performance parity on key tasks.
▪️Inference: Frameworks including vLLM, SGLang, Ray, llm-d and AIBrix are accelerating execution and continually reducing costs.
▪️Training: PyTorch, DeepSpeed, Ray, Kubeflow and TorchTitan underpin much of today’s model ecosystem.
▪️Infrastructure: Linux, Kubernetes, containerd and Volcano provide the open backbone of the cloud.

When open technology advances this quickly, closed ecosystems struggle to keep pace.

Watch the full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7Y7HuOzwB4E
title: Jim Zemlin: How Open Source Powers the Entire AI Stack | Open Source Summit Korea 2026
